scope: Research-only resolution of candidate import blockers. No runtime hiking source data, generated public data, route files or shared scripts were edited.

staticImportReadiness.reasonImmediateRuntimeImportIsFalse: Runtime import and generated-data edits are explicitly out of scope for this worktree. The remaining items are implementation/currentness checks, not unresolved trail identity research.

summary: All eight official stages now have enough evidence for candidate normalization handoff.
The previous not-import-ready items were resolved as normalization decisions, suppression decisions, protected-area overlay decisions or volatile-data policies.

Route geometry still needs a separate normalization implementation pass before runtime import, but the research no longer has an unresolved main/alternate choice that should block candidate normalization.
Transit, fire bans, forestry notices, business hours, bathing quality and shelter maintenance are volatile and should not be treated as durable static trail facts.

routeNormalizationDecisions.decision: Model one official stage with explicit variants. Do not import the incomplete full-stage Naturkartan GPX as stage geometry. Prefer a primary/default geometry that aligns with the current official 31 km display by using the direct south shortcut, while preserving the official north alternatives via Djäknatorp and Djäknasundet and the Källebacken/Undenäs route as alternate geometry.
evidence: Current official stage display/PDF uses 31 km.
Full-stage Naturkartan GPX downloaded during research was incomplete at about 16.95 km and did not reach Forsvik.
Official Google/Naturkartan segment accounting shows longer Källebacken variants around 35-37 km and direct-south estimates around 29-31 km depending north branch.
routeNormalizationDecisions.importHandling: Ready for candidate normalization; runtime app must support or explicitly suppress alternates before generated import.

routeNormalizationDecisions.decision: Use Forsvik-Fröjden, direct Fröjden-Bygget and Bygget-Mölltorp as the primary continuity route. Preserve Fröjden-Skackastugan and Skackastugan-Bygget as an official shelter-side alternate/branch.
evidence: Official/Naturkartan segment GPX totals about 11.9 km for the direct line and about 13.3 km through Skackastugan/Bergsudden.
The official 13 km headline can be preserved as display distance while measured branch lengths remain geometry metadata.
Mölltorp endpoint mismatch is an OSM boundary issue, not an official-source uncertainty.
routeNormalizationDecisions.importHandling: Ready for candidate normalization; direct branch is primary, Skackastugan/Bergsudden is alternate/facility-side geometry.

routeNormalizationDecisions.decision: Assemble the two official mainline segments in official order and keep Klevaberget as a separate side spur. Do not import the raw OSM boundary mismatch at Mölltorp.
Assemble the four official mainline segments in official order and keep the Skarpås shelter spur separate.
Reverse both official GPX components, assemble them in official Hjo-Baståsen order, and deduplicate the small Baståsen backtrack.
Use the official mainline in correct direction and preserve side spurs separately.
Model the continuous mainline from First Camp Hökensås to the Gagnån/stage-8 junction, plus the official Fagerhult access connector as separate access geometry.

Model one official stage with two reversed Naturkartan/Smålandsleden GPX child components, a Fagerhult access connector, and a Hotel Mullsjö to Mullsjö centrum access connector. Prefer the Naturkartan Hotel Mullsjö endpoint and keep the OSM/E1 endpoint as access cross-check.

protectedAreaOverlayResolution.method: Official Naturvårdsverket Naturvårdsregistret and Natura 2000 REST/WKT boundaries were checked against current Naturkartan/official GPX route components using SWEREF99 TM point/segment overlay logic. This was a research pass only; no normalized geometry files were created.

decisions.decision: Do not apply national-park rules section-wide to stage 1. No official stage-1 GPX component checked in this pass intersected the national-park boundary.

decisions.area: Valekleven-Ombo öar, Granvik, Bölets ängar, Bölskullen and Håketjärnarna
decisions.decision: Apply protected-area rules only to stage-1 route variants or connectors that actually overlap those protected areas. Stage-wide rule attachment would be too broad.
Stage 3 and the start of stage 4 overlap Stora Röå. Use Stora Röå rules for the overlapping route/facility context.
No direct main-route hit found in the current overlay. Do not attach Röå alsumpskog rules unless a future connector or revised geometry proves overlap.
Stages 4 and 5 overlap Hjoåns dalgång. The mapped Hjoåns fire/rest point is inside the reserve boundary and should remain suppressed or pending because the standing reserve rule prohibits fire.
The Hjo route is near the lake/Natura 2000 area but the checked route line did not intersect the protected water polygon. Do not attach water-area rules unless a water/shore connector is modeled.

Stages 6 and 7 overlap Hökensås NVO; stage 6 also intersects Hyltan. Hållsdammsbäcken shelter lies in the Hökensås NVO context, not in Gagnån. Apply Hökensås NVO rules to Hållsdammsbäcken rather than Gagnån no-fire/no-tenting rules.
Stage 8 overlaps Gagnån at the start/Gagnån area. Stage 7 comes close at the endpoint but should not receive Gagnån no-fire/no-tent rules for Hållsdammsbäcken or the broader stage-7 facility set.

decisions.area: Ryfors, Stråkens strandskogar, Västra Fagerhult, Norra Fågelås and nearby Mullsjö/Stråken areas
decisions.decision: No direct main-route overlap was found for the checked route components. Keep these as nearby/continuation context only unless future access geometry proves overlap.

protectedAreaOverlayResolution.remainingRuntimeRequirement: Repeat the overlay against the final normalized route geometries before generated runtime import if the normalization process changes route components or connector inclusion.

decisions.decision: Current Västtrafik line 402 confirms Baståsen A and Baståsen B stop records valid 2025-12-14 to 2026-12-12. This resolves the earlier statement that Baståsen had no confirmed current transit, but exact stop-side coordinates and walking connector still need verification before importing Baståsen as a high-confidence coordinate POI.
decisions.confidence: high for current line/stop names, medium for endpoint access because stop coordinates/connector are not verified

decisions.decision: Do not import old Rödåkra/line 405 text as current transit. Västtrafik's Skaraborg change page says line 405 Hjo-Tidaholm was withdrawn and points Hjo-Tidaholm travel to new line 415 or Närtrafik. Current line 405 on Västtrafik is a different Svaneholm-Kinna service.

decisions.topic: Hjo, Hökensås, Fagerhult and Mullsjö access
decisions.decision: Keep existing current transit candidates but recheck planner data before runtime display. Current official pages support line 321 Tidaholm-Hökensås, line 406 Hjo-Brandstorp/Fagerhult and line 415 Hjo-Korsberga-Tidaholm for the 2025-12-14 to 2026-12-12 timetable period.

transitResolution.runtimePolicy: Transit schedule availability is volatile. Candidate files can store stop/line/source evidence and caveats, but runtime display should requery Västtrafik/JLT/Resrobot before publishing current departures or access promises.

facilityImportDecisions.decision: Suppress or keep pending; do not import as usable fireplace without an official exception. Overlay places it inside Hjoåns dalgång, whose reserve rules prohibit fire.
Model as Hökensås-context shelter/rest facility, not Gagnån-context no-fire/no-tenting facility. Keep roof/maintenance currentness and fireplace usability pending for runtime display.
Do not import lakes, streams or springs as potable unless a reliable official drinking-water source is verified. Keep natural water as non-potable/caveated context only.

facilityImportDecisions.topic: Commercial services and optional town businesses
facilityImportDecisions.decision: Keep only first-party/current services with coordinates as candidate records; otherwise leave as optional access/service context pending currentness and app-scope decisions.

volatileDataPolicy.decision: Do not hard-code same-day fire-ban state from research. Use MSB Brandrisk Ute/Krisinformation/Länsstyrelsen or municipal fire-ban sources immediately before runtime display.

Treat forestry notification overlays as a volatile pre-publication check, not static trail data. Skogsstyrelsen provides open geodata/MapServer access for avverkningsanmälda områden; exact polygon-to-normalized-route-buffer overlay should be run only after final route normalization.

volatileDataPolicy.topic: business hours, campsite/shop opening, bathing quality and shelter maintenance
volatileDataPolicy.decision: Leave these as currentness checks before runtime display. Do not block candidate normalization on them unless the app intends to import the specific facility as a live service.

remainingBeforeRuntimeImport: Implement normalized route/alternate/connector geometries in a separate safe pass.
Repeat protected-area overlays against the final normalized geometry set if geometry changes.
Verify exact coordinates for Baståsen A/B and any other transit stop intended as a coordinate POI.
Run exact Skogsstyrelsen polygon-to-route-buffer overlay only after route normalization.
Recheck same-day fire bans, transit planner output, business/service hours, bathing-water quality and shelter maintenance before public runtime display.
